messages:
olivia (CSM): quick heads-up — Nuvora Health tokens down ~65% last 30d, new procurement lead replaced prior champion. saw ping about competitive pilot with OrionAI. worried about renewal in 60d. attaching quick snapshot: tokens 30d=18M (was 52M), active routes down 3 -> 1. any context?

raja (AM): thanks olivia. got a note from CFO last wk asking for cost comparison vs Orion. do we have recent eval notes and perf numbers? Can we request a call with their new PM next week?

emma (CS Ops): I'll pull the eval runbook and last 2 months of latency/cost per 1K tokens. quick query I use:
```
SELECT date, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM billing.usage WHERE customer_id='nuvora' AND date > now() - interval '60 days' GROUP BY date;
```
sending CSV in 10.

usage-bot: anomalous_usage_alert: customer=nuvora, drop_pct=65, window=30d, link=https://console.redd/usage/alerts/nuvo-123

tony (SE): on product side — they were using our chat endpoint w/ prefix caching. we can propose a batching/quantization config that should cut cost ~30% without quality loss. happy to do a brief walkthrough and run a quick A/B on their sample prompts.

jen (RevOps): renewal terms — current commitment ends in 60 days, MRR = $14k, committed tokens 1.2M/mo but they're underutilizing. we could offer a 90-day Dedicated trial or a 10% renewal credit tied to usage recovery. need approval for concessions.

olivia (CSM): proposed plan: 1) schedule 30m call w/ new PM + CFO — ask for use-cases and Orion pilot details (raja to lead). 2) SE deep-dive and cost-reduction plan (tony) 3) run targeted eval vs Orion with our cost/perf numbers (emma + tony) 4) RevOps to draft concession options (jen). I'll send calendar invites. any objections?

raja (AM): fine. I'll set the call for Tue or Wed next week. pls share meeting prep doc. @tony, can you prepare 2 slide summary on perf + quick wins?

tony (SE): yep. will attach slides by EOD Mon and include a short demo script.

jen (RevOps): I'll draft 2 concession scenarios and margin impact.

emma (CS Ops): CSV uploaded to the shared folder: link https://drive.red/nuvo-usage.csv. also attaching last eval snapshot.

olivia (CSM): thanks team. tagging @ce-ops to see if we can enable a short Dedicated trial. We'll aim to have a mitigation plan before the exec call.
